accepted_scope.product_summary: Forms covers workplace form authoring, form rendering, response collection, validation, export, distribution, anonymous/public submission where explicitly allowed, and bounded AI-assisted form build suggestions/drafts.

personas.description: Tenant operator or workplace admin creates, edits, publishes, distributes, and archives forms.
needs: draft and publish forms with policy-preview acknowledgement
configure fields, validation, branching, accessibility, data-class labels, and respondent audience
see warnings before publishing high-risk, inaccessible, or policy-denied forms

personas.description: Authenticated or explicitly anonymous submitter responds to a published form.
needs: avoid hidden or unauthorized field persistence

personas.description: Tenant administrator exports, searches, audits, and deletes/handles response data under policy and compliance constraints.
Auditor or compliance principal reviews forms evidence without raw answer leakage.
needs: audit-chain seals and replayable evidence references
residency, DPIA, accessibility, and data minimization proof

personas.description: SRE or service operator keeps the response, export, webhook, captcha, and AI-build paths observable and safe.
needs: SLOs, dashboards, runbooks, fail-closed controls, and rollback paths
alerting for submission, export, captcha, replay, and policy drift failures

user_stories.story: As a tenant form builder, I can create a form draft with typed fields and validation so that the published form has an auditable schema.
acceptance_evidence_plan: RED fixture for CreateForm/FormDraft with required title, fields, data-class labels, and invalid-field rejection
domain/kernel tests for duplicate fields, required answers, field kind validation, and data-class defaults

user_stories.story: As a tenant form builder, I can preview policy, accessibility, and data-class warnings before publish so that unsafe forms fail closed.
acceptance_evidence_plan: contract fixture for publish requiring policy_preview_acknowledged and auto_decision_screening
capability fixture proving T0 suggestions never write state or reveal raw PII

user_stories.story: As a respondent, I can submit a response to an accepting published form through a scoped token and captcha gate so that abuse and unauthorized persistence are rejected.
acceptance_evidence_plan: OpenAPI fixture for /public/forms/{form_runtime_token}:submit success and captcha/rate-limit/expired failures
server-authoritative branch/permit replay fixture before response persistence

user_stories.story: As a data admin, I can list and export responses only through entitlement-gated, redacted, auditable paths.
acceptance_evidence_plan: RED fixture for pii_unredacted=false default and Cedar-denied pii_unredacted=true without entitlement
export job fixture for csv/xlsx/json/sheets-bridge queueing without synchronous raw-data leakage

user_stories.story: As an auditor, I can inspect evidence for form publish, submit, DSR, webhook, and AI-build decisions without seeing raw response values.
acceptance_evidence_plan: AsyncAPI fixture for audit-chain seal fields on form and response events
logic replay fixture storing hashes and permit ids instead of raw answer values

user_stories.story: As an operator, I can detect and mitigate response pipeline, captcha, export, and replay failures using documented SLO/runbook evidence.
acceptance_evidence_plan: SLO fixture selection for submission latency, PII encryption correctness, WCAG correctness, and export latency
runbook evidence plan for captcha degradation, export failure, response-store corruption, spam flood, and PII leak incident handling

required_red_assertions: tenant-scoped authenticated endpoints require OIDC bearer unless explicitly public
public submission requires runtime token plus captcha and fails closed when captcha is unavailable
publish requires policy preview acknowledgement and auto-decision screening attestation
response listing/export defaults to redacted PII and requires entitlement for unredacted access
contract examples cover validation, conflict, forbidden, not found, rate-limit, expired, and fail-closed responses
events include tenant/pack scope and audit-chain seal metadata
payloads do not carry raw answer values where hash/reference evidence is sufficient
failure events distinguish validation, captcha, schema, policy, upload, rate-limit, and internal errors
Form, Field, Response, and AiBuild messages carry data-class, pack, audit, and version fields needed by REST/AsyncAPI parity
server authoritative submit/publish methods preserve policy-preview, captcha, and audit-chain invariants

red_first_fixture_sets.purpose: Draft/create/edit form schema with data-class labels, validation, duplicate-field rejection, and schema hash/version behavior.
Publish gate requires policy preview acknowledgement, WCAG 2.2 AA checks, auto-decision screening attestation, and fail-closed policy behavior.

Browser/user-story evidence for the form builder and renderer: keyboard-only authoring, screen-reader labels/errors/help text, focus order, branching preview, plain-HTML fallback rendering, mobile/desktop responsive submit flow, and WCAG 2.2 AA regression capture before Build.
Public submit endpoint validates runtime token, captcha, required answers, hidden/denied answers, expiration, tampering, and rate limits.
Response listing/export is redacted by default, entitlement-gated when unredacted, and emits export job/audit evidence.
CEL branch result and Cedar permit decisions produce replayable visible-path evidence and reject hidden PII persistence.
AI-form-build T0/T1/T2 paths remain bounded, labeled, policy-checked, and non-load-bearing until accepted by a tenant operator.
Submission latency, PII encryption correctness, form render, field validation, export latency, AI build, WCAG correctness, and runbook failure-mode fixtures are selected before build.

mechanical_checks_before_build: OpenAPI parser/linter for oya/forms/contracts/openapi/forms.openapi.yaml once a RED card owns contract validation
AsyncAPI parser/linter for oya/forms/contracts/asyncapi/forms.asyncapi.yaml once a RED card owns event validation
protoc or buf validation for oya/forms/contracts/proto/forms.proto once a RED card owns proto validation
Browser/user-story accessibility replay for form builder and renderer once a RED card owns UX validation
domain/kernel tests for oya/forms/crates/oya-forms-domain before adapter/runtime work
fixture_and_test_plan.review_gate: Create or use a Review/fix child card before RED or Build fanout; no implementation card may cite this file as reviewed until that child approves it.

data_classes: PHI when pack/use case requires healthcare handling
FINANCIAL only when a payment field is explicitly selected and gated
security_controls: OIDC bearer for authenticated tenant operations
HMAC-signed runtime tokens plus captcha for public submission
Cedar policy preview before publish and per-question permit before answer persistence
column/envelope encryption for PII response data
default-deny/fail-closed behavior for unavailable captcha, Cedar, policy bundle, or evaluator mismatch
raw answer values excluded from audit events when hashes or references satisfy evidence needs
compliance_controls: pack-aware residency and compliance constraints for kr, eu, us, us-healthcare, jp, sg, au, in, br, ae, and ksa
DPIA prompts for high-risk auto-decision screening and regulated forms
DSR event and deletion/export evidence without copying payloads into automation evidence
audit-chain seals on publish, submit, AI-build, DSR, webhook, and distribution events
accessibility_controls: plain-HTML or degraded rendering path must preserve form semantics and labels
accessibility correctness fixtures selected before renderer build

browser evidence must exercise builder and renderer user stories with keyboard navigation, screen-reader labels/errors, focus order, responsive layout, and visible unavailable/expired/rate-limit states
observability_controls: submission latency, field validation latency, render latency, export latency, bulk distribution latency, AI-build latency, PII encryption correctness, and WCAG correctness SLO candidates
dashboards/runbooks are inventory seeds only until verified by RED/Build/Review evidence
